title: Public API invoice shows the Bill To and keeps customer as the customer
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Use a Public API key for the test organization, the Public API documentation, and a tool that sends API requests.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the customer the work is for.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced, billed to customer B.
custom_steps: 1. Send GET for work order 1's invoice through the Public API (the single invoice request in the documentation).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The response is 200.
  • It has a Bill To field naming customer B.
  • The existing customer fields still name customer A.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12321 (Story 19, IBS, invoice export and Public API)
